JD Highlighter can show the account icons in the status bar again, and it idles quietly when JD's window is narrow.

## ✨ Added

- **An Account bar switch.** JD Highlighter hides the row of account icons in the status bar. Settings › User Interface now has an Account bar switch that brings it back, right away and without a restart.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **No more busy CPU at idle on a narrow window.** When JD's window was narrower than its toolbar's contents, the toolbar was laid out again on every pass, which queued the next pass straight away, about 900 times a second. The toolbar is now only realigned when it is actually out of place. [@mmenanno](https://github.com/mmenanno) found and fixed this in [jdownloader #66](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/pull/66).
